evals.prompt: A Modal run failed with ModuleNotFoundError for a local module at /root/train_dit.py during container startup. What is the cause and the fix?
evals.expected_output: Container hydration imports the /root-mounted entrypoint before any function body runs; the image copies live in /app, so sys.path must include /app before the first local import, and the image sets PYTHONPATH=/app.

evals.prompt: I added a new src module that src/train_dit.py imports. What must exist before dispatching a GPU slice?
evals.expected_output: The whole src/ package is mounted with add_local_dir into /app, and scripts/check_modal_container_contract.py passes before dispatch.

evals.prompt: The container startup import fails. Can we wrap it in try/except so training continues?
evals.expected_output: No. Removing the import or swallowing the error would silently downgrade checkpoint verification; it must fail loudly.

evals.prompt: Does the same contract cover the classifier and the Kaggle slice?
evals.expected_output: Yes: src/train.py mounts the same package, and the Kaggle workspace must pack every src/*.py plus EXTRA_KERNEL_FILES.
